item.title: [SwiftHFR] Account button after the back button of a category's topic list (#425)
item.body:
Closes #425
Claim: cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet)
Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/fb-quickwins-reviewer-opus-r3)

### What was checked
#1059 (merged as 995dbd80) put the account button, top left with the avatar, on the five tab roots. Not done: a category's topic list, a pushed screen. Legacy shows back, then the account avatar there (`MainWindow.swift:803-818` @ 87fe0d1c; operator comment of 2026-11-14 on #425).

### Problem
A category's topic list (Catégories content column, and the category opened from a Favoris section title) has no account button.

### Change
- `TopicListView.showsAccountMenu` (off by default) adds `AccountMenuButton` at `.topBarLeading`, drawn after the back button. `TopicsColumn.showsAccountMenu` passes it through.
- On: Catégories' topic column (only when the split is collapsed, `horizontalSizeClass != .regular`) and the category pushed from Favoris. Off: the Favoris root (its tab already adds the button).
- Not touched: the topic lists pushed in the regular-width sidebar root (`CategoriesSidebarColumn`, where the sidebar carries the button); legacy has the avatar in the iPad list column, `MainWindow.swift:1932-1938`: follow-up #1147. And Plus (the operator's "remove from Plus" is marked *to confirm* on #425).
- `CategoriesTabView` takes an optional initial column, so a test can start on the topic column; `TopicListView.overlay` moved into a same-file extension to stay under SwiftLint's type length.

### Review
Round 1 (REQUEST CHANGES, 4) and round 2 (REQUEST CHANGES, 2 medium, 2 detail) handled; round 3: **APPROVE** on `b862dfae` (conditional on the `App build + tests` job being green on the head, since these tests have never run, and on the body edits below, now made). Verdicts posted on the PR. Merges of `dev-swift`: `d27aa3bf` clean (empty `--remerge-diff`); `b862dfae` is a single-parent commit (comment shortened, `overlay` moved to an extension).

### Tests
`AccountMenuPlacementTests`: `aPushedCategoryTopicListHasTheAccountButtonOnlyWhenAsked` (true/false, negative control) and `theCategoryTopicListsOfTheTabsHaveExactlyOneAccountButton` (`CategoriesTabView` with `selectedSource`, `FavoritesTabView` with `openedCategory`, compact window; exactly one left item on the pushed bar). Not run (Linux); the Compile check is green on the head. At regular width the tab root no longer exists (LOT-147: `usesSidebarRoot` sends every regular-width scene to `RootSidebarView`), so no regular-width test; the device check is listed on #893.

### Ledger

```gap-edit
GAP-009
Legacy ref: MainWindow.swift:235-262; MainToolbar.swift:57-64 @ 2440d79; MainWindow.swift:803-818 @ 87fe0d1c
SwiftHFR final: Avatar menu, top left, on the five tab roots and, at compact width (iPhone, and an iPad in Slide Over or Split View), after the back button of a category's topic list (#425, #1059); not in the split root (iPad, a foldable's inner screen), where the sidebar has it and its pushed topic list does not yet (#1147); manage-accounts entry added; Plus keeps it pending the operator's call.
```

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/fb-quickwins-reviewer-opus, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES**, head 60155c1

1. **Medium**, `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootTabsView.swift:68`. The tab root runs at regular width on a foldable's inner screen (GAP-215, `tabSplitSizeClass` keeps `.regular`). There the Catégories split shows all three columns, so `ForumListView` (`:66`, `.accountMenuToolbarItem()`) and the topics column (now `showsAccountMenu: true`) each draw an avatar, side by side. Legacy shows one there: its sidebar has none (`MainWindow.swift:1880-1902` @ 87fe0d1c). Fix: in `TopicsColumn`, show the button only when the split is collapsed (`horizontalSizeClass == .compact`; `TabSplitWidth` already sets that value inside the columns).
2. **Medium**, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Accounts/AccountMenuPlacementTests.swift:164-176`. The test only checks `TopicListView`'s flag. If `showsAccountMenu: true` is removed at `RootTabsView.swift:68` or `:166` (the real fix), every test stays green (L01). Fix: host `CategoriesTabView` with `selectedSource` set, and `FavoritesTabView` with `openedCategory` set, in the compact 402-pt window. Expect exactly one leading item: that also catches a duplicate on the Favoris root.
3. **Low**, `AccountMenuPlacementTests.swift:52-57` + `:173`. `readBars` stops at the first `isOnTheLeft`, and `leftControls` can become true from the back button alone. In the `true` case the loop can stop before SwiftUI installs the leading item: `leftItems == 0`, and the test fails at random. Fix: in this test, poll until `leftItems > 0` or the timeout.
4. **Low**, PR body `### Ledger`, GAP-009. "after the back button of a category's topic list" is wrong on iPad: the topic list pushed in `CategoriesSidebarColumn` (`RootSidebarView.swift:171`) has no avatar. Legacy's iPad list column has one (`MainWindow.swift:1932-1938` → `:803-818`). Fix: port it there, or limit the text to the iPhone tab root and track the iPad case on #893. The block parses (`ledger.py check-body`: 1 block ok). Also consider adding `MainWindow.swift:803-818 @ 87fe0d1c` to `Legacy ref`.

**Vérifié**
- Read the diff and the legacy code at 87fe0d1c (`ForumTopicsListView` toolbar, iPad `selectedIPadListContent`, sidebar).
- Checked the duplicate-button cases: Favoris root, the iPhone compact split, iPad sidebar root, the foldable tab root.
- Checked the memberwise init order, `if` inside `.toolbar`, and line lengths (none over 140).
- Ran `ledger.py check-body` on the PR body.
- Not run: the app cannot be built on Linux, and the PR does not compile-check it yet.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/fb-quickwins-reviewer-opus-r2, round 2): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 18751a4

Round 1 status: finding 3 is fixed (the pushed-list test stops on `leftItems > 0`, and the `Text` root has no leading item). Findings 1, 2 and 4 are only partly fixed.

1. **Medium** — `AccountMenuPlacementTests.swift:194` (`theCategoryTopicListsOfTheTabsHaveExactlyOneAccountButton`). The `{ $0.leftItems > 0 }` predicate also matches the root's own account button: `ForumListView.accountMenuToolbarItem()` in Catégories, and `TopicsColumn.accountMenuToolbarItem()` on the Favoris root. If the root's bar is read before the push or the `.content` column settles, the loop stops with `leftItems == 1` and the test passes even when `showsAccountMenu: true` is removed at either call site. Nothing shows that the bar read is the pushed list's bar. The PR also never shows this test failing without the change (L01). Fix: count only bars whose `backItem != nil`, or require `topItem?.title == "Matériel"` both in the `until` predicate and in the assertion. Then run the test with the call-site flag removed and record the red result.
2. **Medium** — `RootTabsView.swift:171` (`horizontalSizeClass != .regular`). The round-1 duplicate fix has no test, because the tests only use a 402 pt window. It also rests on two unverified assumptions:
   - SwiftUI passes `.regular` from `TabSplitWidth` into a column of an expanded split. A column's trait collection may be compact, which would bring the duplicate back.
   - The sidebar column is visible. In a three-column `.automatic` split the sidebar can be hidden, which would leave no account button on screen.

   Fix: add a case with a wide window, `.environment(\.horizontalSizeClass, .regular)` and `.environment(\.tabSplitIdiom, .phone)` that expects exactly one account button. If that is not practical, list the foldable check on #893.
3. **Detail** — `### Ledger` GAP-009: "on the iPhone" is wrong in both directions. A compact iPad (Slide Over, Split View) also gets the button, and on a foldable's inner screen the Catégories topic column has none. Suggested wording: "at compact width (iPhone, and an iPad in Slide Over or Split View)".
4. **Detail** — `RootTabsView.swift:160`: `MainWindow.swift:1880-1902` @ 87fe0d1c is the iPad sidebar list and does not show the claim. Cite the account item of the list column instead (`:1932-1938`, as the PR body does).

The new `init` is fine: the `@Bindable` assignment, `State(initialValue:)` and the default `.sidebar` keep the `RootTabsView` call site unchanged. The `\.isOnTheLeft` default argument is a valid conversion from a key path to a function (SE-0249).

**Verified**: the `60155c1..18751a4` diff and the full branch diff; legacy `MainWindow.swift:795-835` and `:1870-1910` @ 87fe0d1c; `swiftlint lint` on the 4 files (clean); `ledger.py check-body --pr 1098` on the live body (1 block ok). Tests not run: Linux, app not buildable here.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/fb-quickwins-reviewer-opus-r3, round 3): APPROVE** (head b862dfae)

This approval depends on two things. First, the `App build + tests` job must be green on this head, because these tests have never run. Second, the two edits to the PR body (findings 1 and 2) must be made. Neither needs a push.

**Round 2 findings:**
- (1) Handled: `pushedLeftItems` counts only bars whose `backItem` is set, and both tests wait on it.
- (3) Handled.
- (4) Handled.
- (2) I accept leaving the regular-width check to #893. Since LOT-147 (`9fd7a822`, brought in by `d27aa3bf`), `usesSidebarRoot` sends every regular-width scene to `RootSidebarView` (`RootNavigationView.swift:115-120`). `TabSplitWidth` forces compact on an iPhone with compact height. So a `.regular` `TopicsColumn` can no longer happen in the tab root.

**Merge and lint:** `d27aa3bf` is a clean merge: `--remerge-diff` is empty. `b862dfae` is a single-parent commit despite its "Merge" title. It only shortens a doc comment and moves `overlay` into an `extension` in the same file, which is correct: a `private` member in a same-file extension is visible to the type (SE-0169), and `@ViewBuilder` is kept. `swiftlint lint --strict` reports nothing on the four files.

**Findings:**
1. **Low, PR body `### Ledger`, `SwiftHFR final`.** The text "not on a foldable's inner screen, where the category list column has it" is wrong since the merge. The inner screen is now the sidebar root (`CategoriesSidebarColumn`, `RootSidebarView.swift:203-218`). Its pushed topic list has no button; the button sits on the sidebar (`:91`). Fix: rewrite it as "not in the split root (iPad, a foldable's inner screen), where the sidebar has it…".
2. **Low, `### Ledger`, `Legacy ref`.** `MainWindow.swift:235-262; MainToolbar.swift:57-64; MainWindow.swift:803-818 @ 87fe0d1c` makes the first two citations read as `@ 87fe0d1c`. At that commit, `:235-262` is not the account menu (`accountMenuItems` is at `:270-290`). Those two are `2440d79` lines: write `… @ 2440d79; MainWindow.swift:803-818 @ 87fe0d1c` (AGENTS §2).
3. **Low, tracking.** The sidebar root's topic lists still lack legacy's button in the list column (`MainWindow.swift:1932-1938` @ 87fe0d1c). They are left "to #893", but #893 only lists device checks. Open a follow-up issue and cite it in the body and the ledger, or use `Refs #425`.
4. **Detail, `RootTabsView.swift:159-161`.** The comment says `TabSplitWidth` keeps `.regular` on a foldable's inner screen; that is stale for the same reason as finding 1. Fix it in the follow-up; it is not worth another push.

**Verified:** `git diff` from the merge base, `--remerge-diff` on both commits, `swiftlint --strict`, `ledger.py check-body --file <body> --pr 1098` (1 block ok), legacy at `87fe0d1c` and `2440d79`, every call site of `TopicListView`, `TopicsColumn` and `usesSidebarRoot`. Tests not run (Linux).

comments.body:
**CI note (cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet).** The real `App build + tests` run on 2a12f15b (run 44409848102) had exactly one failing test of 2162, one of mine: `AccountMenuPlacementTests.theCategoryTopicListsOfTheTabsHaveExactlyOneAccountButton(tab: "favorites")` at `:199`, `found.pushedLeftItems == 1`.

Cause (from the test's own diagnostics in the log): the `categories` case passed (the pushed bar had the « Comptes » item), but in the `favorites` case the read bar was still the Favoris **root** bar (right items 2, no back item): `navigation.openedCategory` was set before the first render, and the `navigationDestination` was never presented, so there was nothing pushed to count. A test bug, not a feature bug: the feature is shown working by the Catégories case and by `aPushedCategoryTopicListHasTheAccountButtonOnlyWhenAsked` (both ran green).

Fix in 19d94da3 (test only): the category is opened 1.5 s after the Favoris list is on screen, as a tap on a section title does. The other 2161 tests passed.
